stage0034_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$!
　Is the Unicorn still not tuned!」

stage0034_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Hurry up...!
　Neo Zeon's surely noticed
　that $c has gone into space!」

stage0034_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「The Red Comet might show up again...!
　The Unicorn will have to deploy too!」

stage0034_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But, Mr. $$アルベルト$$...
　From what $$カミーユ$$ said, the red machine that appeared
　after Industrial 7 wasn't $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s...」

stage0034_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Then who was piloting the $$シナンジュ$$!?
　It came at three times the speed in that red machine!」

stage0034_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't ask me,
　how would I know that...」

stage0034_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Mr. $$アルベルト$$'s really worked up, isn't he」

stage0034_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「He's been like that ever since
　Neo Zeon declared war」

stage0034_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カツ$$
「In his own way, he's on edge over the Zeon threat」

stage0034_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Who knows...
　Seems like Mr. $$アルベルト$$ only cares
　about the Unicorn, if you ask me」

stage0034_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ファ$$
「Have you found out anything more
　about the NT-D since then?」

stage0034_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Not a thing.
　I've been logging the unit's data to hand
　over to Mr. $$アルベルト$$ after the battle, but...」

stage0034_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Nothing much worth noting.
　...Well, the data does confirm one thing,
　that $$バナージ$$'s getting the hang of it」

stage0034_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$n
「Even in simulation
　he's pulling a 72 percent kill rate at Grade II」

stage0034_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$n
「...69 percent at the same Grade II」

stage0034_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$n
「...Don't remind me.
　I'm bothered by it too」

stage0034_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Oh, is that so.
　You don't show it much, so I never noticed」

stage0034_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$n
「...It's fine.
　I'm not fighting to beat $$バナージ$$ anyway」

stage0034_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シン$$
「But losing to a junior stings, doesn't it?
　I'll join you for training today」

stage0034_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$シン$$
「Don't worry about it.
　Everyone's trained with me before too」

stage0034_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$n
「I'm counting on you, $$シン$$.
　I want to study the Destiny's
　weapon combinations as reference」

stage0034_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$シン$$
「That said, I don't have it fully mastered either.
　It only works if I sharpen my focus
　to the absolute limit」

stage0034_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$シン$$
「I picked it up with help from me...
　$$カミーユ$$...and, um, someone else」

stage0034_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$シン$$
「That's the thing... I just can't remember」

stage0034_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シン$$
（I feel like that person
　meant a lot to me, but...）

stage0034_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$n
「I've always thought $$シン$$'s style of fighting,
　pushing the unit's full performance, was amazing,
　but how did you come up with those tactics?」

stage0034_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$シン$$
「...It's not that I don't remember that part,
　it's more that I don't want to...」

stage0034_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$シン$$
「It's a style I developed to fight $$キラ$$」

stage0034_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「$$キラ$$, as in $$キラ・ヤマト$$!?」

stage0034_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「He's one of $$ＵＣＷ$$'s super aces.
　Word is he's got power said to be the strongest
　even among Coordinators」

stage0034_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$n
「A Coordinator...
　someone with innate talent from gene manipulation」

stage0034_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Maybe $$バナージ$$ could be
　a Coordinator too, huh」

stage0034_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$シン$$
「That's a stretch.
　$$バナージ$$ wasn't even born on $$プラント$$」

stage0034_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$カツ$$
「But if that's true,
　it'd explain $$バナージ$$'s piloting skill...」

stage0034_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$シン$$
「What, $$カツ$$...
　jealous of $$バナージ$$'s skill?」

stage0034_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$n
「Then you should join the training too」

stage0034_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$カツ$$
「I'll pass.
　No way I can keep up with you two」

stage0034_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カツ$$
（$$バナージ$$'s crazy, but so is $n.
　Only a few months in and already past
　60 percent kill rate at Grade II, unreal...）

stage0034_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$シン$$
「Can't be helped.
　Guess I'll rope in $$カミーユ$$」

stage0034_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$n
「Now that you mention it, I haven't seen him...」

stage0034_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$カミーユ$$'s shut himself in his room.
　Says he's got something to think over」

stage0034_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$n
「We'll be arriving at Londenion soon
　to rendezvous with the $$ラー・カイラム$$.
　Maybe I'll invite him out to unwind...」

stage0034_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$カツ$$
「I hear $$ハサウェイ$$'s in Londenion,
　he'll probably point you to a good spot」

stage0034_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$シン$$
（$$カミーユ$$...
　you're still shaken over Captain $$クワトロ$$...）

stage0034_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$シャア$$
「...Well then, Mr. President...
　Now that the wartime law agreement is settled,
　you and your aides will be released」

stage0034_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$大統領$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$... there's still time now.
　Won't you reconsider?」

stage0034_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$シャア$$
「If my resolve were light enough to waver now,
　I'd never have taken up my father's mantle」

stage0034_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$シーリン$$
「We gave you every bit of data $c gathered
　on whoever it is that wants this war.
　Even so?」

stage0034_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$クラウス$$
「With invaders from other dimensions and
　worlds appearing, you must understand
　humanity has no room to fight itself」

stage0034_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シャア$$
「That was merely a hint of what's to come...」

stage0034_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's exactly why.
　That's exactly why I believe humanity
　must change」

stage0034_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Now all the preparations are in place」

stage0034_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シャア$$
「Seizing the President the moment we
　declared war was underhanded, I'll admit」

stage0034_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$カイザス$$
「With Earth supremacists growing in strength,
　a meeting between the President and Supreme
　Commander could never happen through normal means」

stage0034_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Had it come to that, lawlessness would reign,
　and we'd even have ended up allowing
　indiscriminate attacks on colonies」

stage0034_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$カイザス$$
「I believe it's precisely because the President
　understood that, that he approved the treaty,
　starting with the ban on attacking habitats」

stage0034_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$シャア$$
「Our first goal is toppling the Earth supremacists.
　There's no need to drag civilians into this war」

stage0034_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$カイザス$$
「No...
　Given the aftermath, I'd call it a wise choice」

stage0034_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$カイザス$$
「In fact, with you rising up, Supreme Commander,
　support for Neo Zeon among the colonies,
　including $$プラント$$, has become decisive」

stage0034_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$カイザス$$
「We also have $$アクシズ$$ on our side.
　We won't fall behind the Federation in resources」

stage0034_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$シャア$$
「But now that we're evenly matched in strength,
　this becomes all-out war with the Federation」

stage0034_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$カイザス$$
「The next task will be winning this war
　as quickly as possible」

stage0034_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I'm going out for a while」

stage0034_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Understood.
　I'll arrange an escort on this end」

stage0034_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$シャア$$
（$$アムロ$$... I won't stop now.
　If you're nearby, try to feel my presence）

stage0034_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Mr. $$カツ$$, Mr. $$アムロ$$!」

stage0034_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$クェス$$
「Of course.
　I'm right here with him」

stage0034_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$クェス・パラヤ$$...
　Why are you here?」

stage0034_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$アストナージ$$
「Her father, Vice Minister $$アデナウアー$$,
　went back to Earth ages ago, but this
　girl's gone and settled down in Londenion」

stage0034_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's been a while, $$アストナージ$$」

stage0034_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$アストナージ$$
「Good timing.
　Someone who wanted to meet you, Captain,
　has come aboard the $$ラー・カイラム$$」

stage0034_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$チェーン$$
「A pleasure, Captain.
　I'm technical officer $$チェーン・アギ$$」

stage0034_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$.
　Pleased to meet you」

stage0034_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Meeting you confirms it.
　White really does suit you, Captain」

stage0034_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Actually, I was once on loan to Anaheim,
　where I helped develop the $$νガンダム$$」

stage0034_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$チェーン$$
「So when we sent the $$νガンダム$$ to $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$
　during the $$多元戦争$$, I took it on myself
　to send a white normal suit to you too」

stage0034_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So that was you back then...」

stage0034_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$チェーン$$
「You look more grown-up than in your old photos.
　I think the white suit fits you even better now」

stage0034_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アストナージ$$
「Quite popular, Captain.
　You didn't earn the ace title for nothing」

stage0034_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Wha... why, I'm this ship's mechanic...」

stage0034_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$クェス$$
「Spoken like an adult.
　That's not what I'm asking.
　I mean your relationship with $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

stage0034_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Relationship... he's a man I admire」

stage0034_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's not it!
　I trained in India so that everyone
　could become Newtypes who understand each other」

stage0034_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's why I was interested in $$アムロ$$,
　the so-called Newtype, so why get in my way!?」

stage0034_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$クェス$$
「To me, that's exactly what you are.
　Get off this ship!」

stage0034_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$チェーン$$
「There's no way I can do that」

stage0034_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Sorry, $$チェーン$$.
　Let's talk properly later」

stage0034_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Cheer up, $$クェス$$.
　Besides, that was rude to $$チェーン$$」

stage0034_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$カツ$$
「Rough on $$ハサウェイ$$.
　Sounds like $$クェス$$ has had him
　wrapped around her finger」

stage0034_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「It's fine.
　She's doing it because she likes it」

stage0034_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$カツ$$
「So, how's that princess of yours
　doing over there?」

stage0034_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't tease me, $$カツ$$.
　What's with 'princess'?」

stage0034_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$カツ$$
「What do you mean, it's just a vibe.
　Everyone says $$オードリー$$ has
　an air of elegance about her」

stage0034_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$オードリー$$
「That's not true.
　At least right now, I have nowhere
　to go」

stage0034_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$リディ$$
「But... your face... I feel like
　I've seen it somewhere before...」

stage0034_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$リディ$$
「That's it...!
　The actress, Natsume Swanson!
　Doesn't anyone say you look like her?」

stage0034_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I don't know much about show
　business...」

stage0034_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$シン$$
「So why is Ensign $$リディ$$ tagging
　along with us too?」

stage0034_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$リディ$$
「Don't be so cold, $$シン$$.
　They say company makes the road
　shorter, right?」

stage0034_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$リディ$$
「Besides, I came to Londenion
　once, as a kid.
　I can show you around a little」

stage0034_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$カツ$$
「An Earth-raised ensign who's actually
　been to a colony before...」

stage0034_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$シン$$
「Ensign, were you actually...
　from a rich family?」

stage0034_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$シン$$
（Watch out, $$バナージ$$.
　The ensign might be after $$オードリー$$）

stage0034_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$バナージ$$
（You mean he's sniffing around after her?）

stage0034_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$シン$$
（That's not it...!
　I mean... he's interested in her
　romantically）

stage0034_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$オードリー$$
「What's wrong, $$バナージ$$?
　You raised your voice」

stage0034_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ファ$$
「So, $$カミーユ$$... feeling a little
　better?」

stage0034_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$シン$$ and $n were worried too.
　You'd shut yourself in your room」

stage0034_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$シャア$$
「Meeting you in a place like this.
　Quite the coincidence...」

stage0034_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What are you trying to do!?
　Are you going to waste what we
　fought for with $$トレーズ$$ and $$ルルーシュ$$!」

stage0034_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$シャア$$
「Unlike you, I can't afford to be
　just a pilot!」

stage0034_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Why would a man who fought beside
　us start another war!?」

stage0034_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you understand!?
　What you're doing is on a different
　scale from $$エゥーゴ$$'s fight with $$ティターンズ$$!」

stage0034_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Even if it doesn't drag people
　into the fighting directly, this
　war will gather so much grief!」

stage0034_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$シャア$$
「But unless mankind advances to a
　higher stage, the history of war
　will repeat itself!」

stage0034_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$クェス$$
（But I understand...
　what $$シャア$$'s saying...）

stage0034_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$シャア$$
「Don't you see, $$アムロ$$!
　Unless the rot is purged completely,
　people and the world will never change!」

stage0034_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シャア$$
「Human ego will destroy the world!」

stage0034_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Human wisdom can overcome
　even that!」

stage0034_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then show me you can grant wisdom
　to every fool alive, right now!」

stage0034_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$シャア$$
「If you can't, mankind is finished!」

stage0034_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's right!
　Because he can't, $$シャア$$...」

stage0034_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$!
　Right here, I'll...」

stage0034_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$, is it...
　Firing without warning is uncouth」

stage0034_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Everything I do is out of concern
　for you, Commander」

stage0034_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$バナージ$$
「There's no mistake!
　He's the one who was piloting
　that $$シナンジュ$$!」

stage0034_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$シャア$$
「We're falling back.
　Any further and this gets troublesome」

stage0034_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$シャア$$
（I see...
　So that's how it is）

stage0034_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$シャア$$
（At least being with them is healthier
　than being a pawn in the game
　at $$アクシズ$$）

stage0034_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$クェス$$
「What are you doing, $$シャア$$!
　Let's go, hurry!」

stage0034_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$シン$$
「Stop, $$ハサウェイ$$!
　Chasing them is pointless!」

stage0034_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$リディ$$
「Back to the dock!
　If Neo Zeon was here, that means
　there's going to be a fight!」

stage0034_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ブライト$$
「What about that $$シナンジュ$$ pilot?」

stage0034_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It wasn't $$シャア$$, someone else.
　But...」

stage0034_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$ called him $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　but his face and voice were just
　like $$シャア$$'s」

stage0034_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ブライト$$
「A body double... is that it?」

stage0034_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アムロ$$
（But it's not just a passing
　resemblance...
　What's his tie to $$シャア$$...）

stage0034_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Commander $$レディ・アン$$ says the
　$$大統領$$ and his aides, held by
　Neo Zeon, were taken in at Londenion」

stage0034_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$シャア$$ must have come to that
　colony to free the $$大統領$$」

stage0034_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But why choose Londenion of all
　places for it?」

stage0034_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...I don't want to think it, but...」

stage0034_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Is he saying that's his idea of
　courtesy to a former comrade...」

stage0034_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ブライト$$
「He's shut in his room, in shock.
　His girlfriend was taken right
　in front of him」

stage0034_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That wasn't a kidnapping.
　$$クェス$$ chose to go with $$シャア$$
　on her own」

stage0034_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I can't bring myself to tell
　Deputy Chief $$アデナウアー$$.
　Not that he cares about her anymore」

stage0034_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Maybe $$クェス$$ was looking for
　a father figure in $$シャア$$...」

stage0034_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ブライト$$
「A father figure, from that man...
　If so, he's grown up more than the
　Captain $$クワトロ$$ we used to know」

stage0034_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Things don't look good.
　We need to build up our own strength
　to counter that $$シナンジュ$$」

stage0034_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Zeta and the $$νガンダム$$...
　I'll see what I can arrange」

stage0034_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If $$シャア$$'s conscious of me...
　of us, he'll show up on the
　battlefield eventually」

stage0034_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...If that's what he wants,
　I'll settle it」

stage0034_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Even if it means making $$ララァ$$
　sad...）

stage0034_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So that guy, $$シャア・アズナブル$$,
　used to fight alongside you all before...」

stage0034_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$葵$$
「Back then, his name was $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$, though」

stage0034_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「To explain in more detail,
　his real name is Casval Rem Deikun...」

stage0034_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「He's said to be the orphaned child of
　Zeon Zum Deikun, who laid the groundwork
　for the Republic of Zeon, Neo Zeon's precursor」

stage0034_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Zeon Zum Deikun was assassinated.
　The Republic of Zeon then became the
　Principality, under Zabi family dictatorship」

stage0034_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So that assassination... Zabi was behind it...」

stage0034_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Casval Rem Deikun came to the same
　conclusion as $$朔哉$$ and the public: to
　overthrow the Zabi family, his father's killers...」

stage0034_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Under the false name $$シャア・アズナブル$$,
　he enlisted with the Zeon military」

stage0034_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「So he chose to strike the top from within...」

stage0034_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「$$シャア$$, having become a Zeon ace, fought
　a desperate duel with Captain $$アムロ$$,
　an ace of the Earth Federation Forces」

stage0034_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「And, after many twists and turns,
　$$シャア$$ succeeded in overthrowing the Zabi family」

stage0034_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「The charisma of $$シャア$$, Zeon's Red Comet,
　became legend, and combined with his
　bloodline, won him support as the next leader」

stage0034_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's the story of $$シャア・アズナブル$$ I read
　in 'Monthly: A Man's Red Comet'」

stage0034_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$くらら$$
「So after being 《$$エゥーゴ$$》's $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$,
　he rose to lead Neo Zeon as its commander...」

stage0034_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$アンディ$$
「But hey, to everyone who fought
　alongside him, that's basically betrayal」

stage0034_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$葵$$
「...Seems like it.
　$$カミーユ$$ especially took it pretty hard」

stage0034_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Both $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$
　have fought those who resort to war, after all」

stage0034_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So how about Team D?
　Is it more like, '$$シャア$$ must pay'...?」

stage0034_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$くらら$$
「War as an act aside,
　when it comes to $$シャア・アズナブル$$ himself,
　there's not much anger or hatred」

stage0034_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Team D's surprisingly cool about this...」

stage0034_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Really...
　Hard to believe how fired up they get in battle...」

stage0034_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Maybe.
　Might not be what you're expecting, but
　we're not hot-blooded all year round」

stage0034_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Still, I intend to brush off any sparks
　that fall on us. If $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　makes us his target, we'll fight full-force」

stage0034_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$カイエン$$
「...Just like a beast.
　Lazes about when its belly's full,
　bares its fangs when danger's near...」

stage0034_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$葵$$
（But, what's this... this frustration...
　There used to be times my heart burned hotter...）

stage0034_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$アンディ$$
「No use thinking about it.
　We're not Team D, but if some old
　acquaintance comes at us, we'll fight back」

stage0034_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$朔哉$$
「I like that.
　I get the same vibe from you as from me」

stage0034_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「No good, $$朔哉$$.
　Turning $$アンディ$$ into the Element's
　resident comic relief just won't do」

stage0034_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「I understand wanting company, though」

stage0034_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$朔哉$$
「I'm not thinking anything like that!」

stage0034_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「It's fine, $$朔哉$$.
　$$アンディ$$'s already locked down
　that position ages ago」

stage0034_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Alright!
　Figures, from the digging man!
　Leave the punchline to the hole expert!」

stage0034_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Saying stuff like that
　is exactly why I get labeled comic relief!」

stage0034_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Alright, alright, that's enough.
　It's already bedtime」

stage0034_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$カイエン$$
「The fight with Neo Zeon continues from here...
　Rest while you still can」

stage0034_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$葵$$
「Got it.
　Guess I'll shower and hit the sack」

stage0034_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$$葵$$, pajamas or a nightgown when you sleep?
　Don't tell me you're a tracksuit type?」

stage0034_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$葵$$
「Too bad, $$アンディ$$.
　None of those are it」

stage0034_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Quit thinking dumb thoughts, $$アマタ$$!」

stage0034_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$葵$$
「Calling a maiden's bare skin dumb
　kind of hurts, though...」

stage0034_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ジン$$
（Oh, fearsome, the $$レア・イグラー$$...
　To think mere words like that could
　shake me up this much...）

stage0034_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Wh, what, the Agent Robo...!
　Don't startle me like that...!」

stage0034_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「You're awfully familiar for a mere robot」

stage0034_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「True, in this world, Anaheim is the sort
　of blue-chip company job hunters would
　kill for, but our $$ＤＥＭ$$ is nothing to scoff at」

stage0034_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Once a route to this world's set up,
　I'd considered trade with Anaheim, but
　if their exec's this stubborn-headed...」

stage0034_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「S, sorry, $$ＡＧ$$!
　No, wait... $$ＡＧ$$ old pal! Mister $$ＡＧ$$! Lord $$ＡＧ$$!」

stage0034_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just a dimension joke, Master $$アルベルト$$.
　This $$ＡＧ$$ wouldn't bring up something as
　petty as an oil discharge port」

stage0034_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In humans, it's an organ in the lower body」

stage0034_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Rest assured, Master $$アルベルト$$.
　I... know full well that you are
　never truly a bad person」

stage0034_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Today's joyful roar when the NT-D
　activated made for a fine Z-Chip」

stage0034_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That comes to 100Z.
　I'll add this to the squad's stock」

stage0034_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, please wait patiently
　for the day the dimensional hole opens」

stage0034_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A pretty girl suits a smile better than a frown.
　If something troubles you, consult this $$ＡＧ$$」

stage0034_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand.
　This is about Master $$カミーユ$$, isn't it」

stage0034_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now's exactly the time for a smile.
　A woman's smile is the sun to a man, after all」

stage0034_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Before he starts ranting hotly about comets,
　Lady $$ファ$$'s smile must save Master $$カミーユ$$」

stage0034_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ファ$$
「...You're right...
　If I sink too while wanting to help
　$$カミーユ$$, that won't help at all」

stage0034_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ファ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$...
　I'll give it a try」

stage0034_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, one last smile practice for good measure...」

stage0034_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go!
　Let's give it our all today too!」
